Micron Technology is a world leader in innovating memory and storage solutions that accelerate the transformation of information into intelligence, inspiring the world to learn, communicate and advance faster than ever.

Job Summary 

As an MTS Design Verification Engineer, you will serve as a technical leader driving innovation in DRAM verification for advanced memory products. This role focuses on leading design and verification strategy, influencing key technical decisions, and ensuring high-quality, functionally correct, and scalable memory solutions. You will collaborate with global teams, guide methodology improvements, mentor engineers, and act as a domain expert to support next-generation DRAM technologies.  

Responsibilities 

Lead DRAM verification innovation, driving key technical decisions, architecture, and strategy during product execution 
Collaborate with global teams to define and implement best-known methods for verification and product development 
Drive verification planning, coverage closure, and silicon debugging for advanced DRAM products 
Evaluate and implement new tools, methodologies, and flows to improve verification efficiency and quality 
Mentor engineers and provide technical leadership while contributing expert guidance to senior leadership teams 

Minimum Qualifications 

Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related field
8+ years of experience in DRAM/memory or advanced CMOS verification 
Strong circuit analysis and debug skills at the transistor level — able to root-cause behavior, not only at the testbench level
Experience with simulation tools such as HSPICE, Finesim, Verilog, or SystemVerilog 
Deep understanding of CMOS fundamentals and semiconductor design principles 
Demonstrated leadership, problem-solving, and ability to collaborate across multiple functions  

Preferred Qualifications 

Advanced degree (Master’s or PhD) in Electrical Engineering or related field, with equivalent experience considered 
Experience with UVM, mixed-signal verification, and advanced DRAM architectures (e.g., DDR5 or beyond) 
Strong background in verification methodology development and coverage strategies 
Experience mentoring engineers and leading technical initiatives across teams 
Recognition as an authority in DRAM build or verification domains  
Strong programming skills (Python preferred) with ability to apply AI-assisted tools (e.g., ClaudeCode) to improve EDA automation, data analysis, and build efficiency

Responsibilities 

Lead DRAM design and/or verification innovation, driving technical strategy and execution.
Collaborate with global teams to develop and share best-known methods across product lines.
Drive circuit improvement, verification planning, coverage closure, and silicon debug.
Define and implement tools, methodologies, and automation to improve quality and efficiency.
Provide technical leadership in mixed-signal simulation, validation, and signoff strategy for DDR5 and beyond.
Mentor engineers and serve as a DRAM authority for senior leadership.

Minimum Qualifications 

Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related field, or equivalent experience.
Strong expertise in DRAM design and/or verification for advanced memory products.
Hands-on experience with tools such as HSPICE, FINESIM, Verilog, and SystemVerilog.
Strong understanding of CMOS fundamentals, semiconductor design, and product development flows.
Demonstrated leadership, problem-solving, and multi-functional communication skills.

Preferred Qualifications 

Advanced degree in Electrical Engineering or related field, or equivalent experience.
Experience with UVM, mixed-signal verification, advanced DRAM architectures, and DDR5+ methodology development.
Background in verification planning, coverage strategy, debug, and silicon correlation.
Experience mentoring engineers and leading technical initiatives across global teams.
Recognized authority in DRAM build, verification, or methodology development.
Strong programming skills (Python preferred) and ability to use AI-assisted tools (e.g., ClaudeCode) to improve EDA automation and productivity.
